Name: DGR 029 - KORYOS
Information:
**DGR 029 - KORYOS**

KORYOS is a unit that is much larger than others constructed in its generation - it was created to act as a hunter and sentry, with an alien form that is meant to confuse targets it goes after. KORYOS was originally made with the intention of being mostly unmanned units that would guard strategic areas with predetermined orders, but the limited initial use of DGR units prevented this from ever happening. This insectoid machine is capable of digging below the ground and sensing the locations of other terrestrial enemies with great ease.

traits.name: Confusing Strikes
traits.description: The many limbs of the DGR strike in a feverish rush, confusing targets. When the DGR misses an attack against a target, the next attack it makes against them on the same turn has advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes four Ferris Claw attacks.

actions.name: Ferris Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sonic Scream
actions.description: The DGR unleashes a chittering, sharp scream as an array of sonic energy, targeting one creature it can see within 90 feet, as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 5) thunder damage, and if any of the d10s rolls a result of 10, the target is deafened until the end of the DGR’s next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Hunting Check
bonus_actions.description: The DGR makes a Perception check, attempting to locate all hidden creatures within the range of its tremorsense.
